notes.title: Upcoming offline progress system
notes.notes:
Hope everyone is doing fine!!

[h1]Offline Progress System[/h1]

[previewyoutube=jUESU6lyWzA;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey all, just wanted to show off how the offline progress is coming around.

The plan is to have a skill called Chronomancy. 
After you unlock Chronomancy, you'll be able to accumulate a time resource. Then, you use that to speed up the battles.

This is for the battle tab. For the Unknown tab, it will be a different resource that is similar. But they progress separately. So that way the player isn't forced to prioritize Unknown tab progress or Battle tab progress. They can also save battle progress to speed up specific challenge fights, so that's nice too.

[h1]So what does everyone think?[/h1]

Btw, if you want to know secret info or participate in future closed playtests my games, sign up here: https://www.perennialhearts.com/gri.html

notes.title: Improvements we are planning to implement & Darkness of Brazil!
notes.notes:
Wanted to share an update on some of the improvements we are planning for the game.

There are some issues that are coming up again and again. 
The first one is the hover widget blocking the stats view. We are planning to fix that in the next update or maybe the one after that.

The second one that comes up often is the "piercing" mechanic. The number is percentage based, NOT a raw value. The reason why it gets higher than a 100 is because there is the safeguard mechanic which is a flat decrease to the percentage of the opponents piercing stat.

A third thing we want to tweak in the game is slashing (melee type skills) being overpowered on certain circumstances. I don't plan to nerf slashing but I want to introduce enemies where high power slashing is not a viable strategy (still possible though). That should allow for counter-attack builds and speed-based builds to be the best possible strategy in more situations.

[h1]The collaboration: Darkness of Brazil[/h1]

So Generic RPG Idle is collaborating with Daily Espada to bring you the Darkness of Brazil bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/30487/Darkness_of_Brazil/

Basically you get a discount for buying both games together! If you already bought one of the games, then you get a discount for buying the other game. Both games are staged in Brazil and have a similar dark lore, which is why the bundle is named that. Some Brazilian foklore characters are in both games!!

notes.title: Bloody Halloween update
notes.notes:
[h1]BLOODY HALLOWEEN[/h1]
As some of you may know, there is a mechanic in Generic RPG Idle called Blood. If you have blood, every attack you use makes you lose HP. In exchange, your attacks grow stronger.

[h2]INTRODUCING DEATH BLOOD[/h2]

There is now a new attribute called Deathblood. Deathblood increases your damage whenever the player has low HP values. Blood helps Deathblood activate.

Furthermore, there are now skills which consume HP instead of MP. This will further help you activate Deathblood.

[h2]Feature List[/h2]

[list]
[*] Equipment that increases Deathblood
[*] A new challenge area enemy called Pumpkin Star
[*] Skills that consume HP
[*] Reaper and Tonberry now increase blood related attributes
[/list]
